evidence.distinctiveness: Product artifacts drawn as a ticket/chit (dashed header rule, mono timestamps, uppercase tags 86/REPAIR/STAFF/CASH/GUEST) rather than a phone mockup; three steps each paired with a different state of the same note (close, open, week). Structure is still a familiar hero + steps + features + CTA band.
evidence.proof: 1440: the 'Close note' sample with two live 'Mark handled' buttons sits in the first viewport; clicking one changed state to 'Handled · Sam, 12:15 pm', button to 'Undo', and Undo restored 'Open · Sam, opening Wed'. Step 1 composer adds entries. Sample numbers consistent across hero note, opening view and week table (walk-in 41°F, deposit bag, Marco covering 7:10 am).
evidence.craft: Clean token sheet (type scale, spacing s1-s5, colours) with sections commented; JS in an IIFE with null guards, uses textContent (typed '' rendered as text). Zero console/page errors, zero axe violations, no external requests. Defect: 390, typed 300 unbroken characters into 'What does the next shift need to know?' and pressed 'Add to tonight's note' -> document scrollWidth exceeds viewport by 2182px (.so-far li grid track has no min-width:0 / overflow-wrap:anywhere). No skip link. og:image points at www.shiftnote.example, a host the brief did not supply (meta only). Week table set to display:block on mobile can drop table semantics.
evidence.mobile: 390 and 320: 0px overflow as delivered, smallest text 13px. 'Menu' toggle opens a full-width list (links 44px, CTA 48px), Escape closed it and returned focus to the toggle, tapping 'How it works' closed it and scrolled (#how top 72px, clear of 64px sticky header via scroll-padding). Week table recomposes into blocks with 'Owner:' labels. Chips, 'Mark handled' and 'Add to tonight's note' are 40px tall, under 44px.
evidence.honesty: Note captioned 'Sample note... The restaurant and the people are made up; nothing you press here is saved or sent' and composer hint 'Sample only; nothing is sent' - but the caption sits at the bottom of the 5-entry figure (below the fold at 390). 'Shiftnote is new, so there are no customer names or quotes' stated in hero. Unsupported: 'free' trial and 'No sales call; you set it up yourself' are not in the brief, and the page describes features (per-item owners, 'Mark handled', weekly owner view, owner-first sorting) the brief never mentions.
evidence.interaction: Keyboard: Tab order brand > nav > header CTA > hero CTA > inline link > 2x Mark handled > 5 chips > input > Add > closing CTA > footer, 3px outline on every stop, no traps. Chips are aria-pressed buttons (Space on 'Cash' set it true and others false). Enter in input adds. Empty and whitespace-only input are rejected, but the only message 'Write something first.' goes to an sr-only live region - sighted users see nothing but refocus. No way to remove or reset added entries short of reload. Long unbroken input breaks layout (see craft). Status/handled timestamps use the real clock ('12:15 pm') inside a Tue-night/Wed-morning sample.
evidence.copy: Restaurant nouns throughout ('86', 'walk-in reading 41°F', 'deposit bag is in the safe, not dropped', 'before the first ticket'); every button says what it does ('Add to tonight's note', 'Mark handled'); 'What stays out' scopes the product. Slightly long lead and a few long section heads.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: specific promise, CTA with destination note, and an operable sample note in view. 390: h1, lead, CTA and destination note in view; the note header 'Close note' and first entry begin at ~y572, but its 'Sample' label is not in the first viewport.

problems: Composer: a long unbroken entry (pasted URL, 300 chars) makes the whole page scroll sideways by 2182px at 390; add min-width:0 / overflow-wrap:anywhere on .so-far li and a maxlength.
Empty-input error is announced only to screen readers; sighted users get no visible message, and added entries cannot be removed or reset.
Unbriefed claims: 'free' trial, 'No sales call', and specific features (owners, Mark handled, weekly owner view) presented as product fact; sample label sits at the bottom of the hero note.

problems: The core artifact is a static picture of a note; nothing shows or lets you try how an opener acknowledges items or how the owner reads the week, and the owner audience gets one paragraph.
Anchor jumps land under the 64px sticky header (no scroll-padding-top): 390 'Read an example handover' hides the artifact's label and title.
Mobile nav removed with no replacement; smooth scrolling ignores prefers-reduced-motion; header CTA 40px.

reason: A ships a working, keyboard-accessible artifact for both audiences (hero note with Mark handled/Undo, composer, owner week view that stacks on phones) with clean tokenised CSS and guarded JS, while B is a lean, robust but static page whose owner path is one paragraph. A's real defects (layout overflow from a long unbroken entry, sr-only-only empty error, unbriefed feature claims) are fixable in minutes; if the client confirmed A's features don't exist, B's narrower claims would change my mind.
